question: 공연장 인근 상권에서 분기별 예정 공연 시작회차와 총매출액·고정 야간매출액은 어떤 관련성이 있는가?
availability_denominator: all official candidate performance IDs per area and source quarter before parsing
availability_numerator: valid registered period + parse_schedule ok + at least one generated regular-weekday scheduled start in same source quarter; exclude own-runtime overlap only when runtime_status ok
start_count_definition: count nominal scheduled start datetimes falling in quarter, regular-weekday recurrence over registered period
holiday_assumption: normal weekday schedules repeated; HOL clauses not combined with a verified historical holiday calendar
night_share_role: descriptive only; prior coefficient may be shown as historical reference, not comparable outcome
exposure_transform: ln(1+known_scheduled_start_count); incomplete sums allowed only in 90pct sensitivity
primary_confidence_interval: individual95pct with t(G-1), CR1 rank correction
common_outcome_sample: nonmissing total_sales>0 and nonmissing night_sales>=0; retain actual zero night sales

multiplicity.sensitivity: same20 family per scenario; exploratory; do not select winning specification

common10_sample: descriptive intersection and coverage only; do not force all10 balanced regression below cluster eligibility

spatial_se_sensitivity.covariance: CR1_factor * bread * area_scores.T @ K @ area_scores * bread
spatial_se_sensitivity.reference_interval: normal approximation95pct only; not exact finite-cluster inference
